title: 37°C heat shock survival assay for C. elegans
author: Emily Troemel

steps_raw.instruction: Note: Grow worms without starvation or bleaching for at least 3 generations at 20°C before testing in this assay.
Pick 30 L4 stage worms to a 6 cm NGM/OP50 plate (standard lab plate stocks). Set up 3 plates for each strain to be tested.
Put all plates in a 37°C incubator for 2 hours. If possible, put plates in a single layer (avoid stacking plates).
Remove plates and place in a single layer on the bench top for 30 minutes to recover before stacking in a box and putting at 20°C.
After 24 hours at 20°C, score worms for alive/dead (if not moving, test reponse to tapping with worm pick and/or look for pharyngeal pumping).
Issues that may contribute to variability in this assay:
Temperature and humidity of incubator (gradient from top to bottom of incubator?)
NGM agar thickness, OP50 lawn size, how dry the plates are
